en: Black‑and‑white aerial view of a small town surrounded by forests and farmland. A railway line with a train and several industrial buildings runs through the town, with clusters of wooden houses and streets on either side. In the bottom left corner the word "Løten" is printed, and in the bottom right appears a logo-like signature with "Oslo" and the code "4.D 5". The style and printing resemble a mid‑20th‑century photographic postcard.
